item.title: Wright’s Gourmet House opens Tampa hospital location
item.description: South Tampa staple Wright’s Gourmet House is opening its first satellite location, at Tampa General Hospital’s Davis Island campus. Wright’s has been serving up sandwiches, salads, and desserts from its home on South Dale Mabry Highway for nearly 60 years, and celebrated the grand opening of its first ever sister location with a ribbon cutting ceremony at the hospital Feb 6. item.title: Swedish construction firm to rebuild Tampa school in $77M project
item.description: Skanska, the Swedish construction firm with a local office, will begin demolition and reconstruction of a Stewart Middle Magnet School in Tampa this month.The $77 million project will create a shared campus for Stewart and the neighboring Just Elementary. item.title: Baltimore Orioles open $23M player development complex in Sarasota
item.description: A new $23 million player development complex has officially opened at the Baltimore Orioles’ spring training headquarters in Sarasota. Project supporters cut the ribbon Monday at the new facility at Ed Smith Stadium, celebrating the year-round opportunities it will provide for athletes.“It’s been a dream for us for a few years,” Mike Elias, Orioles president of baseball operations, said at the ribbon cutting. item.title: Report: Affordable apartments in Tampa have increased 49% since 2020
item.description: The number of new affordable housing qualified apartments in Tampa has grown 49% in the past five years, according to a just released report from RentCafe.The national apartment search website found metro Tampa completed 3,711 fully affordable apartments between 2020 and 2024 out 48,522 apartments built. item.title: Allegiant adds three nonstop routes at St. Pete-Clearwater airport
item.description: Allegiant Airlines is once again adding new flights out of St. Pete-Clearwater International Airport (PIE), bringing the airport’s total number of nonstop destinations to 63 cities. Those new routes, the airport announced Tuesday are to Atlantic City, New Jersey beginning Feb 13; Trenton, New Jersey beginning Feb. 20; and Huntsville, Alabama beginning March 5. item.description: A new intimate Japanese dining experience is opening this week at University Town Center. Yugen will welcome diners on Wednesday to its location at 190 N. Cattlemen Road, adjacent to sister restaurant Zoto Sushi.Encompassing 1,000 square feet, Yugen will feature a “kaiseki” menu showcasing a range of classical Japanese cooking methods, including raw, grilled, steamed, simmered and fried dishes. item.title: Bankrupt Eddie Bauer joins growing list of retailers closing Florida stores
item.description: Another retailer is shutting down stores in Florida.This time it’s the operator of Eddie Bauer stores, which is closing its three remaining locations in the state after filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy Monday. item.title: TGH to open Innovation Center in Ybor City
item.description: Tampa General Hospital will celebrate the grand opening of its new Innovation Center on Wednesday on the eastern edge of Ybor City — a milestone moment for the hospital that comes as it celebrates its annual Innovation Week. item.title: Sarasota family office acquires large manufacturing plant
item.description: Nickolas Asset Management, a Sarasota-based family office owned by Nickolas Reinhart, has acquired a manufacturing plant. The 120,000-square-foot facility was owned by Material Difference Technologies, a plastic resin supplier and processor headquartered in Bradenton.
